title: fix(console): the marketplace Versions panel marks a code-plugin version hosted environments refuse
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8UXdhWKofuH9papUXWszoth)_

Refs objectstack-ai/cloud#4305 (item: marketplace marker)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:托管环境和控制台里的应用市场详情页,代码插件版本旁多一个灰色「托管环境无法安装」标记和一句去处说明;自托管环境不变。
- 为什么做:属于计费与套餐文案一致性那张卡的应用市场一项,替托管客户提前说明哪些版本装不上,而不是点了安装才被拒。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是标记多显示或漏显示,安装行为本身不变,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` Versions card: where the page installs through the control plane's door (no install-local surface: a hosted environment's console, and the control plane's own console), a version served with `contains_code: true` gets a muted "Not installable on hosted" badge beside its version number and one muted line: "A code plugin: hosted environments do not run code plugins. Install it on a self-hosted or Enterprise runtime." (the server's own CODE_PLUGIN_UNSUPPORTED way out). Metadata versions and self-hosted readers (install-local mounted) see no change.
- The predicate is `!features.installLocal`, the same read `primaryAction` routes the install on, not the narrower `hostedModeDoor`: cloud's install door refuses every code plugin and installs into hosted environments only, and the control plane's console (cloudUrl empty, installLocal false) reaches that door too, which `hostedModeDoor` would miss.
- Two new keys `marketplace.detail.notInstallableHosted` / `notInstallableHostedReason` in all eleven locales of the `marketplace` namespace pack (zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`). `@object-ui/i18n` publishes that pack through `./namespaces/marketplace`, so the additive key is the `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- Changeset `cloud-4305-hosted-code-version-marker.md` (patch: app-shell, i18n).

## Tests

New pin `MarketplacePackagePage.hostedCodeVersion-4305.test.tsx` over the real runtime-config boot: hosted environment + code-plugin version → badge and reason; control plane console + code-plugin version → badge and reason; hosted + metadata version → none; self-hosted with install-local + code-plugin version → none.

<details><summary>Readings (head 52e1be0f)</summary>

- Red at base (test commit a77382ab, before the fix): Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4), the two positive cases.
- `vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/`: Test Files 63 passed (63), Tests 600 passed (600).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n test`: Test Files 111 passed (111), Tests 2028 passed | 13 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0.
- ui `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` exit 0; product-neutral ratchet 34 passed.
- Not measured locally: the whole app-shell suite (2433 files, stopped after 42 min on the shared box), declared to CI's Test UI.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Separate finding, not widened here: on a runtime without install-local, the install dialog's code disclosure and acknowledgement describe `latest_version`, but the console sends no version and the control plane resolves "latest" skipping code plugins, so it installs an older metadata release (or answers 422 CODE_PLUGIN_ONLY_PACKAGE when every version is a plugin). Reported to the seat.

## Verification

Read first: `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` (the `codePluginsRefused` predicate and the Versions card), then the new test.
Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.hostedCodeVersion-4305.test.tsx` shows 4 passed.
